note: Budgets for the prerendered pages, from the first build of phase 0 (#475) plus about 8% room. Raise one only in a pull request that says why. `why` says what a page's JavaScript is, measured on the build that set the budget.

/terms.why: No JavaScript of its own: 107100 B gzip is the shell (the bottom bar island and React), the same as /about.

/privacy.why: No JavaScript of its own: 107100 B gzip is the shell, the same as /about.

/releases.why: No JavaScript of its own: 107100 B gzip is the shell, the same as /about. The notes are HTML, built from releases/.

/help.why: The shell plus 660 B of inline script for the FAQ buttons (6749 B inline against 6089 B on /about). The Radix accordion the Next.js page ships is not loaded: the FAQ is plain markup.

/status.why: The shell plus the StatusDashboard island (109891 B gzip, 2791 B over the shell): the health checks are read in the browser from the Worker's /v1/status, which is the point of the page, so the island loads at once.
